description: This file implements the RunC container management class and related functionalities, including container creation, execution, state retrieval, and deletion, using the runc command-line tool within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Encapsulates the execution of runc commands, managing container lifecycle operations such as create, exec, delete, and state retrieval, with support for logging and environment variable inheritance.

classes.name: Runner::Info
classes.description: Represents the container state information, including PID and status, parsed from runc's output.

classes.name: Runner::Config
classes.description: Represents the container configuration, including environment variables, loaded from config.json.

classes.name: Runner::Config::ProcessData
classes.description: Holds process-specific configuration data, such as environment variables, for container creation.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Implements the IContainer interface for managing a runc-based container, including start, stop, status, and resource monitoring.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new container with specified ID and bundle path using runc.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the container, optionally with parameters.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the container, with optional timeout.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the container, including PID and status.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists all containers in quiet mode.

methods.name: InheritHostEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Loads environment variables from the host into the container's environment based on config.json.

methods.name: InternalPurge
methods.description: Stops and removes the container if it is running.
